text: {"lessons":["Selling winners too quickly can leave me exposed to losses elsewhere; I should judge each position by its future prospects, not just whether it is above my cost.","My reluctance to sell at a loss has led me to hold through portfolio declines; I should set clear reasons to exit and follow them even when it is painful.","A few trades and short-term price moves do not establish a sound strategy; I should review the whole portfolio and make deliberate decisions rather than letting gains feel rewarding and losses feel unbearable."]}
